environment.kind: isolated local PostgreSQL and full local app
environment.transport: node-postgres fixture replacing only the database adapter; actual Better Auth, canonical application services, outbox worker and read projection

acceptedDecision.rule: Only new events after activation; no historical backfill. Activation is durable and idempotent.

acceptance.evidence: Real producer commands; subscribed Bob mentioned; committed events delivered twice concurrently in reverse order; one grouped issue, exactly mention/comment/update in order, current title, self events suppressed; real worker replay does not add activity.
Private-team membership removed before worker evaluation; no Bob recipient activity persisted and authorized query empty.

validation.lint: Changed app/fixture source: zero errors. Inbox component retains two existing optional-matchMedia warnings. Shared environment/telemetry packages covered by TypeScript and their 45 focused tests; app ESLint base ignores those external package paths.

additionalPostgresCoverage: no-backfill activation and unchanged repeat activation
activation waits for pre-existing uncommitted appends
transaction begun before activation appends with the post-activation clock
unsubscribe suppresses optional activity; direct mentions and assignments remain eligible
previous delivery hidden after access loss and comment deletion
fanout failure rolls back recipient activity and receipt; safe retry
clientCoverage: ignores forged publishInboxUpdate in canonical mode
only opaque device action metadata persisted
late responses fenced on session invalidation and account switch
failed local writes preserve unread state and report failure

checks: Bob signs in through actual Better Auth
one issue entry with latest title and one mention plus later update
open marks read; mark unread updates entry/badge
private-team revocation removes the previously delivered entry on refresh

separateScope: production-like migration rehearsal, authorized deployment/activation and live scheduler/monitoring acceptance
